claims.goal: Build Lauren's Green & White family reunion PWA, preserving all approved panels and features with simple older-user-friendly flows.
claims.acceptance: Phone/tablet native-feeling responsive PWA; tablet doubles as desktop. Terra Prime/ctrl/Relay design, deep forest dark and pale sage light, brighter green actions, rounded buttons, tree logo, small consistent primary-action glyphs, labeled bottom nav. Photo-first Instagram/simple Facebook familiarity. Feed, polls, admin/mod media first, microprofiles, confirmed family connections and ancestors, RSVP, household bulk-shirt selection, reusable reunion years, planner/admin/treasurer permissions, sign-in for private data and writes. External verified PayPal.Me and Cash App contribution links; app does not hold funds. Self-reports pending until treasurer verifies receipt. Preserve every feature and panel; simplify flows and progressive attention with reduced-motion behavior, not feature removal. Isolated resettable test mode with sample content and no real side effects. No credentials, bank account opening or transfers authorized. Prototype is not proof of production auth, persistence, payments or native installability.
claims.next_action: Commit the first working private visual shell and explicit product/security roadmap. Then add photos and softer colors, preserve approved panel content while improving guided flows. Direct Julian only, no workers.
